Workout Plan Generator

Generate a weekly workout program by goal, training days, equipment and level — with exercises, sets, reps and rest times.

📖 How to use

  1. Choose your goal, training days per week, equipment and level.
  2. Press Generate program.
  3. Follow the day-by-day plan with sets, reps and rest.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the program built?

Pick Build strength, Build muscle, Lose fat or Endurance, then your days per week, available equipment and experience level.

Do sets and reps change with the goal?

Strength uses heavy 5×5 compounds, muscle uses 3–4×8–12, fat loss adds circuits and cardio finishers, endurance uses higher reps and shorter rest.

What equipment do I need?

Full gym, dumbbells-only, or bodyweight — the exercise pool adapts to what you have.

Is this private?

Yes, everything is generated locally in your browser.
